title: Printed translation sheet
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 1: Shape; position and direction; decimals
source: Seeded from mathematics/y5 lesson 74 (Printed translation sheet)
intro: Lesson 74: Translation. To understand how to translate a shape on a grid and describe the translation

blocks.text: Square ABCD has corners A (2, 2), B (4, 2), C (4, 4) and D (2, 4). Translate it 4 right and 3 up. Write the new coordinates.

questions.model: Teacher moves each corner 5 right, then joins.

questions.q: Describe: A to B on the sheet.
Translate the shapes on the sheet as shown.
questions.model: Teacher does the first slide: 3 right.

questions.q: Describe each translation from shape P to Q, R and S.
questions.a: Q: 4 right 1 up; R: 5 down; S: 2 left 3 down

questions.q: Translate P 3 right and then 3 left. Where is it?
A translation can change... A) position B) size C) shape
Big question: what changes and what stays the same?
questions.a: The position changes; size, shape and the way it faces stay the same
